Routines

top source red::diversitycalib

SST pipeline

red::diversitycalib [, threshold=float] [, nref=integer] [, pref=string], dir=dir, nslaves=nslaves, nthreads=nthreads, verbose=verbose

Find the amount of defocusing of the diversity camera.

Keywords

threshold in optional type=float default=0.25

Threshold for identifying a strong enough pinhole.

nref in optional type=integer default=5

How many of the strongest pinholes to use for finding the approximate transform. Afterwards a refinement is made using >80% of the detected pinholes.

pref in optional type=string

Indicate the prefilter you want to calculate the clips for, Default is to do it for all prefilters there is data for.
